item.title: Green GSM Launches Premium Taxi Service In The Philippines
item.description: Green GSM, an all-electric ride-hailing platform, launched Premium Taxi, an upscale seven-seat taxi service in the Philippines. Using the VinFast Limo Green, the service is designed set a new standard for the high-end electric taxi segment in the market. Read More »

item.title: Jetour GAIA G700 Is The Official Vehicle For Discovery's "Adventure Of Extremes" Season 2
item.description: The Jetour Gaia G700 has been selected as the official vehicle for Season 2 of Discovery’s Adventure of Extremes, a groundbreaking global partnership that marks world-renowned explorer Ed Stafford’s first-ever collaboration with an automotive brand. Read More »

item.title: Inchape Philippines Loses Changan, The Third Brand It Has Lost This 2026
item.description: It’s official: Inchcape Philippines just lost itself another brand. Having already lost their sole Mazda dealership and the distributorship of Stellantis’ Chrysler, Jeep, Dodge, and Ram brands , they’re set to lose Changan. Read More »

item.title: Isuzu Drives Modern Public Transport In Batangas With NPR PUV Turnover
item.description: Isuzu Philippines Corporation (IPC), together with dealer partner Isuzu Calapan, turned over two units of the Isuzu NPR85 Class III PUVs to Perlas RCG Transport Tours Corp., a transport cooperative based in Ibaan, Batangas. Read More »
